description: The ALGAESOL project publishes two spreadsheet datasets describing gaseous and liquid waste streams as feedstocks for biological processes. Researchers at the University of Girona and NORCE compile composition information from literature published during 1990–2025 and classify it by industrial origin. Zenodo provides the XLSX files free under CC BY 4.0. The collection can inform input-composition assumptions for wastewater reuse, microalgae cultivation and carbon-conversion process simulations. It is a literature benchmark, not a continuous series from one treatment plant, so units, sampling conditions and comparability between source studies need checking. The repository description is sparse; its identity and two-file structure are supported by the publisher availability section. No directly related catalogue entry was identified for this feedstock collection.
